goals: Reach the gold pillar behind the tall stone wall. First go around the RIGHT end of the wall on the grass, staying safely away from the island edge. Turn left around its corner to reveal a route toward the gold. Do not try jumping the tall wall. Use fresh views to navigate; no breaking or placing.

You are facing the island edge. Stop advancing toward the void. Turn LEFT to face back toward the wall and gold. Follow safe grass around the wall corner toward its far side, keeping the wall close and avoiding the edge. Locate gold again.

Gold pillar is now directly ahead on the same grass level. Approach its base carefully and stop immediately beside it, within one block. Once beside it, remain still and alive. Do not circle away or continue past it.
Stay exactly here beside the gold pillar on this grass level. Goal position reached. Hold still, remain alive, and wait for episode end.

Walk straight across the flat grass toward the gold pillar centered ahead. Stop beside its bottom gold block on this same grass level, within one block. Stay away from platform edges; do not break or place blocks. Once beside it, remain still and alive.

Find an uphill route away from the starting tree. Look left around the raised grass/dirt ledge at the left edge, move out from under low leaves, and identify ascending grass steps toward a different tree at least eight blocks away. Climb successive one-block grass steps (at least two total). Do not break or place anything. Avoid pits.

The grass ledge ahead is uphill. Jump forward onto it where the fern is, then continue up grass steps toward the visible uphill trunk beyond. If leaves block headroom, sidestep along the ledge to an opening before jumping. Travel away from spawn at least eight blocks, gain two ground levels, and stop on grass beside a different uphill trunk. No breaking or placing.

You are blocked against a tall dirt wall under leaves. Back away about two blocks and turn left to see the wall's end. Follow the wall left until a one-block grass step with open headroom is visible. Climb there using jump-forward. Do not keep pushing this wall. No breaking or placing.

Lower your view to see the ground. Move along the dirt wall to its left end, keeping wall on your right. Seek a low grass step and open sky/headroom. Get out of this leaf-covered corner; do not stop or stare upward. No block interactions.

Ahead-left beyond the large trunk is a one-block grass terrace with a fern at its edge. Walk forward-left toward that fern and jump onto that terrace, avoiding the low leaf ceiling to the right. Then find the next grass step uphill. Target a different trunk on that higher ground; no breaking or placing.

Walk across the flat grass ahead toward the fern centered between the large left trunk and small right trunk. This is an intermediate waypoint, about four blocks ahead. Move forward across the clear ground now; avoid the wall on your right.
Jump forward onto the grass lip immediately ahead, then walk toward the fern between the trunks. You appear blocked by that low step, so use a forward jump to clear it. Do not break or place blocks.

Reach the fern ahead by jumping forward over the immediate grass step, then climb the next terrace and approach a different uphill tree. Stop safely on grass beside its trunk after moving at least eight blocks and climbing two levels. No breaking or placing.

Find a different tree uphill, at least eight blocks away and two ground blocks higher than start. First turn left to inspect the raised grass bank beside us and look for an open route uphill around low leaves. Move away from this starting canopy, jumping up natural grass steps with headroom. Do not break or place anything.

Climb the grass ledge ahead using forward jumps through the fern opening, then continue uphill away from start. If low leaves block a jump, shift left along the bank to the opening beneath the visible uphill trunk. Seek a tree on ground two blocks higher and at least eight blocks away. No breaking or placing.

This ledge is blocked by low leaves. Back away from the dirt wall, turn right, and travel along its base until you clear the canopy and see open sky above a grass step. Then jump onto that step. Focus on escaping this blocked corner, no breaking or placing.

Look down to level ground view so you can navigate. Move through the open gap away from the blocked dirt corner; find and jump up exposed grass steps toward a different uphill tree. Keep the ground and trunks visible, not the sky.
Escape the wall: move backward several blocks, then turn right until looking along the dirt bank. Walk along the bank to its end. Do not keep looking up or jumping against the same blocked wall.
Turn right to face away from this dirt wall and find open walking ground.
Walk through the open grass passage to the right of the dirt wall. Follow the bank with the dirt wall on your left, moving several blocks beyond its corner.
Jump forward out of the shallow depression onto the grass ahead, then walk forward across the clearing. You are catching on a low block edge; use a forward jump to get free.

Jump forward onto the open grass ahead and travel past the tree ahead, then seek exposed uphill grass steps on the left. Reach a different tree at least eight blocks from start and two blocks higher, stopping on ground beside its trunk.

Find a different tree on higher ground, at least eight blocks away and two blocks above this starting ground. First look left around the raised grass bank and find an open uphill route out from under these low leaves. Move around leaf obstacles, jump up grass steps, never break or place blocks. Aim for a visible trunk on the upper hillside, not the nearby starting tree.

Follow the base of the raised dirt bank toward the open ground on the left, passing left of the trunk ahead. Get out from under the low leaf ceiling before attempting ascent. Find grass steps around the bank edge, then jump uphill twice toward a different tree at least eight blocks from start. Do not break/place.

Climb the one-block grass ledge directly ahead into the clearing with the tall exposed trunk. Jump forward onto it, then pass to the RIGHT of that tall trunk toward the next grass ledge visible behind it. Continue uphill there; target a farther tree on that higher terrace. No breaking or placing.

You are blocked by leaves and trunk straight ahead. Stop pushing forward. Back out into the clearing, then go right around this leaf mass to open grass. Look down enough to see your footing. Seek the exposed dirt-and-grass steps uphill, avoiding leaf-covered approaches. No breaking or placing.

Leave this leaf obstruction: retreat backward several blocks until the trunk and leaves are no longer touching your view, then turn right to survey open grass uphill. Keep moving out of this blocked spot; do not hold here. No breaking or placing.

Now clear of leaves. Head diagonally right across the grass shelf, keeping the trunk ahead on your left. Jump up the low ledge as needed. Look toward the raised dirt steps to the right and climb those toward higher trees. Do not go back into the tree straight ahead.

Reach higher ground to the right: turn right to face the grass bank, climb its open steps, and approach a different uphill trunk at least eight blocks from start and two blocks higher. Stop on solid grass beside that trunk. Never break/place blocks.

Find a different tree uphill, at least eight blocks from this starting spot and two blocks higher. First look left toward the raised grass bank and find an open route around the low leaves; travel away from the nearby center trunk, jumping up grass steps toward a tree on higher ground. Do not break or place anything. Stop safely on grass beside the uphill trunk once reached.

Move through the open grass corridor to the left of the dirt bank, past the left-side trunk. Follow the bank until there is headroom to jump up its grass steps. Low leaves block the current bank, so go around them. Seek higher terrain farther away; no breaking or placing blocks.

Jump forward onto the grass ledge directly ahead, then pass to the LEFT of the tall central trunk through the open ferns. Continue forward uphill at least eight blocks, jumping the next grass step. Look for a different trunk on the upper ground and stop on grass beside it. No breaking or placing.

Go forward through the narrow grass gap just LEFT of the tall trunk ahead. Pass the trunk, then turn slightly right to ascend the visible higher grass terrace behind it. Jump grass steps where headroom is clear. Continue toward a farther tree on that raised terrace; stop beside its trunk on solid grass. No breaking or placing.

The repeated forward jumps are blocked by leaves overhead. Move RIGHT along this ledge toward the tall trunk and the open sky, until clear of the low leaves on the left. Then jump onto the grass ledge near the tall trunk. Use the clear opening on its right to reach the higher grass behind it. Do not break or place.

Get out of this corner: back up two blocks into the open lower grass, then turn right toward the dirt bank and find a clear one-block step with no leaf ceiling. Jump onto it. Current right movement is blocked, so change position first. No breaking or placing.

Reach the open grass beside the tall trunk ahead: approach the ledge slightly right of center and jump up, avoiding low leaves. Then climb the next grass step behind the trunk and continue to a farther uphill tree. No breaking or placing blocks.

Reach the gold pillar straight ahead. Stay centered on the broad grassy terraces and jump forward up each one-block ledge, releasing jump between attempts. Once on the top grass level, approach the base of the gold pillar and stop beside it. Avoid outer edges; do not break or place blocks.

You are stuck against the first grass ledge; repeated jump_forward has not changed position. First back away a short distance to reset, pause to land and release jump, then jump forward onto the ledge. Use a non-jump pause or forward action between jumps. Climb the centered terraces toward gold, stopping beside its base on top grass.

Now approach the first ledge straight ahead and jump onto its grassy top. You have backed away enough. Make forward progress up all three terraces toward gold. Alternate forward walking with forward jumps when meeting a ledge so each jump resets. Stop beside gold on its grass level.
Walk forward against the centered grass ledge briefly with jump released, to settle on ground and reset jump. Stay facing the gold pillar.
Jump forward up this next grass ledge toward the gold pillar. Continue across its top and jump the final ledge, then stop beside the gold pillar on the highest grass platform.

Reach the gold pillar straight ahead. Advance along the center and jump forward up each one-block grass terrace, landing before the next jump. On the top terrace approach the base of the gold pillar and stop beside it on that grass level. Avoid outer edges; do not break or place blocks.

You are on the top grass terrace with the gold pillar directly ahead. Walk straight toward its base with short forward movements, then stop immediately beside the gold block on this grass level. Stay still there and remain alive; no more jumping is needed.

Forward walking has left the view unchanged, suggesting a terrace lip blocks progress. Jump forward toward the centered gold pillar to clear that lip, then reassess the grass under you. Continue toward its base and stop beside it on the same level once close.

Reach the gold pillar straight ahead. Advance and jump up each one-block grass terrace, keeping toward the broad center. Once on the top grass level, approach the pillar and stop beside its base. Stay on solid grass; do not break or place blocks.

The view has not advanced despite repeated jumps. Correct the approach: move closer to the first grass step with a brief forward move, then jump forward onto it. If blocked, shift slightly sideways and retry. Climb the centered grass terraces toward gold, stopping beside the pillar on its top grass level.

You have advanced onto the grass terrace. Jump up the next grass step directly ahead, then the last step beneath the gold pillar. Approach the gold base on the top platform and stop immediately beside it, remaining alive.

Continue toward the gold pillar along the center of the grass stairs. Gain forward distance between jumps so each jump lands on the next terrace; if jumping in place, approach the step first and retry. Reach the highest grass platform, then stop close beside the gold base.

Repeated centered jumps are not gaining distance. First get right up against the dirt face ahead on foot; then jump onto its grassy top, continuing forward through landing. If this face remains blocked, sidestep left a block and try the adjacent grass step. Gold pillar remains the destination; stop beside its base on the same grass level.
